summary: Software Development Engineer with 5+ years building production financial-services software, approaching six years, and hands-on experience using and building agentic AI systems for personal projects. Strong foundation in Java, Python, event-driven systems, performance engineering, database reliability, observability, and machine learning. Published peer-reviewed research in Cognitive Computation on a Hybrid Social Group Optimization method for COVID-19 chest X-ray detection, achieving over 99% accuracy. Interested in applying production engineering, empirical evaluation, and practical AI-system building to reliable, beneficial AI deployments.

bullets: Designed and developed XTP, ION's real-time back-office trading product, used in production by major trading firms and banks.
Led a Java multithreading refactor that increased trade-processing performance by 20x during end-of-day processing.
Developed Alazium, a log-analysis initiative that parses logs exceeding 100 GB and visualises workflows with Plotly, reducing production issue-analysis time by 30%.
Designed a recovery feature for halted end-of-day processing, enabling automatic recovery from fail-fast scenarios and reducing downtime by 90%.
Worked with XTP's in-house MQ-like, Kafka-like event-driven notification system, understanding its internal workings and operational failure points.
Redesigned historical-data cleanup using a tailored linear-regression approach, improving database performance and reducing processing time by 95% under load.
Led migration of XTP CI systems from Red Hat 7 to Red Hat 8, supporting reliable engineering delivery.
Developed a Daily Run Sheet Generator with a Django frontend to optimise deliveries and presented the application to the company founder for deployment approval.
